description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'patience' diff algorithm implementation in a version control context. It defines test scenarios for diffing files with specific options, particularly focusing on ignoring whitespace at end of lines, and calls external testing functions and scripts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs a series of commands, and checks for specific output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Runs a diff test with a specific pattern or method named 'frobnitz'.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Runs a diff test for unique line detection using 'patience'.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
